landing.faq2A: 24GO monitors public Telegram groups and VK communities 24/7. Our AI analyzes every message in real-time, identifies users with purchase intent based on keywords, context, and behavior patterns, and scores them as HOT, WARM, or COLD leads.

wiki.section.overview.title: Platform Overview
wiki.section.overview.forWhat: 24GO is a platform for automating customer discovery in Telegram and VK. It helps real estate agents, travel agencies, and any business find potential buyers without manual searching. Without automation, you spend hours monitoring chats and lose hot customers.
wiki.section.overview.architecture: The architecture is simple: Accounts → Monitoring → Leads → Sales. Each step is automated.
wiki.section.overview.howTo:
Sign up and choose a plan
Add 1-2 Telegram accounts to start
Find target groups via search
Start monitoring — AI begins analysis
Receive and process leads
wiki.section.overview.expect:
First leads appear within 24-48 hours after setup
Results depend on activity in selected groups
More accounts = wider reach
wiki.section.overview.tip: Start with the free trial (3 days) to make sure the platform fits your business.
wiki.section.accounts.title: Accounts
wiki.section.accounts.forWhat: Accounts are working Telegram profiles through which the system monitors and sends messages. Without accounts, the platform cannot work with Telegram. Each account works independently, like a separate employee.
wiki.section.accounts.howTo:
Click "Add Account" in the Accounts section
Enter Telegram phone number (+7...)
Receive verification code in Telegram
Enter the code in the system
Wait for warmup (3-7 days, 5-15 messages/day)
wiki.section.accounts.expect:
1 account = 5-20 messages/day after warmup (depends on account)
Recommendation: 100 accounts for 1000 mailings/day (gradually increase to 2000)
"Warmup" status is normal — Telegram limits new accounts
"Banned" status means you need a new account
wiki.section.accounts.accountTypes:
Which accounts to use:
• Accounts aged 3+ months — lowest ban risk
• Accounts with profile photo, bio, and history — look human
• Avoid brand new accounts — high ban risk even after warmup
• Buy aged accounts from trusted sellers only — check reviews
• Each account needs its own proxy — sharing IPs = guaranteed ban
wiki.section.accounts.tip: Add accounts in advance. Warmup takes 3-7 days, and until it's complete, mailing volume is limited.
wiki.section.accounts.warning: Don't use one account for too many mailings — it will lead to blocking. Follow the recommended limits.

wiki.section.rules.title: Lead Rules
wiki.section.rules.forWhat: Automatic classification of messages by keywords. Allows you to finely configure which messages are considered hot leads and which are spam.
wiki.section.rules.howTo:
Click "Create Rule"
Enter a name (e.g., "Buyers")
Add keywords separated by commas ("buy, price, cost")
Select classification (HOT/WARM/COLD/SPAM)
Set priority (higher = checked earlier)
wiki.section.rules.expect:
Rule accuracy: 70-85%
Combination of rules + AI = maximum accuracy
Rules checked by priority, then AI heuristic is used
wiki.section.rules.tip: Start with simple rules for HOT and SPAM. Add finer settings over time as data accumulates.
wiki.section.rules.scoring: Each rule has a keyword match score and a priority weight. Higher priority rules are checked first. If a message matches multiple rules, the highest-priority match wins. AI classification acts as a fallback when no rule matches.
wiki.section.rules.scoringFormula:
final_score = keyword_match × priority_weight
If score >= threshold → classified by rule
If no rule matches → AI heuristic takes over

wiki.section.autoReplies.title: Auto-Replies
wiki.section.autoReplies.forWhat: Automatic response to incoming messages. Three modes: keyword matching (responds when keywords match), AI-agent (generates contextual replies using your service description), rotation (randomly selects from prepared answers).
wiki.section.autoReplies.howTo:
Click 'New Auto-Reply'
Enter a name for the rule
Select mode: Keywords, AI-Agent, or Rotation
For Keywords: enter comma-separated trigger words
For AI-Agent: describe your service in the prompt field
For Rotation: add multiple answers, one per line
Click 'Create'
wiki.section.autoReplies.expect:
Keyword mode: instant reply when message contains trigger words
AI-Agent: contextual reply generated by AI based on your prompt
Rotation: random answer selection prevents repetitive responses
Variables: {first_name}, {username} available in reply text
wiki.section.autoReplies.tip: Start with Keyword mode for common questions. Add AI Agent for complex queries. Use Rotation to keep responses fresh.
wiki.section.proxies.title: Proxy Management
wiki.section.proxies.forWhat: SOCKS5 proxies ensure each Telegram account has a unique IP address. Without dedicated proxies, multiple accounts on the same IP will be banned.
wiki.section.proxies.howTo:
Go to Proxies section
Click 'Add Proxy' or 'Bulk Import'
Enter SOCKS5 proxy URL (format: socks5://user:pass@host:port)
Assign proxies to accounts via 'Random Assign' button
Or manually assign per account in Accounts section
wiki.section.proxies.expect:
1 proxy = 1 account (permanent assignment)
Bulk import supports multiple proxies at once
Random assign shuffles and matches proxies to accounts
Health check tests connectivity to Telegram servers
wiki.section.proxies.tip: Buy proxies from a reliable provider. Use residential proxies for better success rates. Datacenter proxies work but have higher ban risk.

vkHelp.title: VK How to Use
vkHelp.overview.title: VK Lead Generation Overview
vkHelp.overview.forWhat: VKontakte (VK) is the largest social network in Russia and CIS. This section lets you generate leads from VK communities by scraping comments, sending direct messages, and posting to community walls.
vkHelp.overview.howTo.1: Go to VK Settings and add your VK API tokens (service token + community tokens)
vkHelp.overview.howTo.2: Add proxies in the Proxies section (one per account recommended)
vkHelp.overview.howTo.3: Connect VK Communities in the Accounts section
vkHelp.overview.howTo.4: Use Group Search (VK) to find target communities
vkHelp.overview.howTo.5: Set up monitoring or comment scraping to collect leads
vkHelp.overview.howTo.6: Create campaigns or mailings to reach out to leads
vkHelp.overview.expect.1: Full VK integration with community token auth
vkHelp.overview.expect.3: Mass DM outreach with account rotation
vkHelp.overview.expect.5: Anti-ban protection with rate limiting and warmup
vkHelp.communities.title: VK Communities
vkHelp.communities.forWhat: VK communities (groups) are where your lead generation happens. Each community needs a community access token to perform actions like reading messages, posting, and scraping comments.
vkHelp.communities.howTo.1: Create a VK community at vk.com/groups if you don't have one
vkHelp.communities.howTo.2: Go to community Settings > API usage > Access tokens
vkHelp.communities.howTo.3: Create a community access token with needed permissions
vkHelp.communities.howTo.4: Go to VK Communities in the dashboard and paste the token
vkHelp.communities.howTo.5: The system will verify the token and show community info
vkHelp.communities.expect.1: Community name, member count, and description
vkHelp.communities.expect.3: Bulk import via JSON for multiple communities
vkHelp.communities.tips: Each community token allows one community to be used. Use multiple communities for higher throughput.
vkHelp.commentScraper.title: VK Comment Scraping
vkHelp.commentScraper.forWhat: Scrape comments from VK community wall posts to find potential leads. Comments are classified by AI to identify hot/warm/cold leads based on message intent.
vkHelp.commentScraper.howTo.1: Add VK communities with tokens first
vkHelp.commentScraper.howTo.2: Go to Group Search (VK) and select a community
vkHelp.commentScraper.howTo.3: Click 'Scrape Comments' on a specific post
vkHelp.commentScraper.howTo.4: Or enable automatic scraping in Monitoring (VK)
vkHelp.commentScraper.howTo.5: Leads appear in the Leads section with AI classification
vkHelp.commentScraper.expect.3: Automatic lead creation for qualified comments
vkHelp.commentScraper.expect.4: Post engagement metrics (views, likes, comments count)
vkHelp.commentScraper.tips: Focus on posts with high engagement. Comments from posts with 50+ comments are more likely to contain leads.
vkHelp.outreach.title: VK Outreach (Direct Messages)
vkHelp.outreach.forWhat: Send personalized direct messages to VK users. Uses account rotation and rate limiting to avoid bans. Supports template variables for personalization.
vkHelp.outreach.howTo.1: Import recipients (from comment scraping or manual list)
vkHelp.outreach.howTo.2: Create a VK Mailing with your message template
vkHelp.outreach.howTo.4: Select number of accounts to use for sending
vkHelp.outreach.howTo.5: Start the mailing — accounts rotate automatically
vkHelp.outreach.warnings: VK has strict anti-spam policies. Start with 5-10 messages per account per day and increase gradually during warmup.
vkHelp.posting.title: VK Wall Posting
vkHelp.posting.forWhat: Automatically post content to VK community walls. Supports spintax for text variation and UTM tracking for analytics.
vkHelp.posting.howTo.1: Create a Campaign in VK Campaigns
vkHelp.posting.expect.4: Post ID logged for comment scraping
vkHelp.posting.tips: Use spintax to create unique variations of each post. This helps avoid duplicate content detection.
vkHelp.autoReplies.title: VK Auto-Replies
vkHelp.autoReplies.forWhat: Automatically reply to incoming messages in your VK communities. Can use AI (LLM) or template-based replies.
vkHelp.autoReplies.howTo.3: For AI mode: configure LLM provider in Settings
vkHelp.autoReplies.howTo.4: For Template mode: add reply templates
vkHelp.autoReplies.howTo.5: Set greeting message for new contacts
vkHelp.leads.title: VK Leads
vkHelp.leads.forWhat: Leads collected from VK (via comment scraping, DM responses, or manual import). Same lead management as Telegram leads.
vkHelp.leads.howTo.1: Leads appear automatically from comment scraping
vkHelp.leads.howTo.2: Or import leads manually via CSV
vkHelp.leads.howTo.4: Update lead status: New → In Progress → Converted
vkHelp.leads.howTo.5: Export leads as CSV for external use
vkHelp.leadRules.title: VK Lead Rules
vkHelp.leadRules.forWhat: Automated rules that process VK leads the same way as Telegram leads. Rules can auto-reply, classify, and route leads.
vkHelp.leadRules.howTo.2: Create a rule with trigger conditions
vkHelp.leadRules.howTo.4: Rules apply to both Telegram and VK leads
vkHelp.leadRules.expect.1: Unified rule engine for all platforms
vkHelp.campaigns.title: VK Campaigns
vkHelp.campaigns.forWhat: Manage posting campaigns across VK communities. Schedule posts, track performance, and A/B test content.
vkHelp.campaigns.howTo.1: Create a campaign with post content
vkHelp.campaigns.howTo.3: Enable A/B testing with multiple variants
vkHelp.campaigns.howTo.4: Monitor post engagement and lead generation
vkHelp.proxies.title: VK Proxy Settings
vkHelp.proxies.forWhat: Proxies protect your accounts by routing VK API requests through different IP addresses. Each account should use a different proxy.
vkHelp.proxies.howTo.2: Go to VK Settings > Proxy Settings
vkHelp.proxies.howTo.5: Test proxy health with the health check button
vkHelp.proxies.expect.2: Round Robin, Random, or Least Used rotation
vkHelp.proxies.tips: Use residential proxies for best results. Datacenter proxies may be detected by VK.
vkHelp.antiBan.title: VK Anti-Ban System
vkHelp.antiBan.forWhat: Protects your VK accounts from being banned. Controls rate limits, random delays, cooldowns, and account warmup stages.
vkHelp.antiBan.howTo.1: Configure rate limits in VK Settings > Rate Limits
vkHelp.antiBan.howTo.4: Set warmup stages for new accounts
vkHelp.antiBan.howTo.5: Enable auto-retry on flood wait errors
vkHelp.antiBan.warnings: Never disable anti-ban protections. VK actively detects and bans accounts that exceed normal activity patterns.
vkHelp.settings.title: VK Settings
vkHelp.settings.forWhat: Configure all VK-related settings: API tokens, rate limits, anti-ban parameters, proxies, and auto-reply behavior.
vkHelp.settings.howTo.1: Go to VK Settings (sidebar > VK Settings)
vkHelp.settings.howTo.2: Add API Tokens (service token, app ID, secret key)
vkHelp.settings.howTo.3: Add Community Tokens for each VK community
vkHelp.settings.howTo.4: Configure Rate Limits based on your needs

hints.vk.serviceToken: VK API service token. Used for reading public data (groups, users, wall posts). Get from https://vk.com/dev
hints.vk.appId: VK application ID. Found in your VK app settings at https://vk.com/apps
hints.vk.appSecret: VK application secret key. Used for server-side authentication.
hints.vk.communityTokens: Add VK community tokens. Each token allows one community to be used for outreach.
hints.vk.msgPerHour: Max direct messages one account can send per hour. VK typically allows 30-50.
hints.vk.msgPerDay: Max direct messages one account can send per day. Recommended: 200-300 for warmed-up accounts.
hints.vk.postsPerDay: Max posts one account can publish per day. Recommended: 5-10 to avoid spam flags.
hints.vk.commentsPerHour: Max comments one account can post per hour. Recommended: 30-50.
hints.vk.minDelay: Minimum random delay between actions in seconds.
hints.vk.maxDelay: Maximum random delay between actions in seconds.
hints.vk.cooldown: After a batch of actions, pause for this many minutes before starting the next batch.
hints.vk.warmupDays: Number of warmup stages. During this period, accounts use reduced limits.
hints.vk.proxyRotation: How to assign proxies to accounts.
hints.vk.proxyList: One proxy per line. Format: protocol://user:pass@host:port
hints.vk.bulkImport: Paste a JSON array of community accounts. Each entry must have group_id (number) and token (string).
hints.vk.replyMode: AI mode uses LLM to generate contextual replies. Template mode uses predefined messages.
hints.vk.greeting: First message sent to new contacts.
